title: Eat a cup of blueberries daily.
subtitle: Anthocyanin dose
rationale: A cheap, pleasant polyphenol dose with small-trial support for memory in older adults.

evidence.summary: Small randomized trials in older adults show modest memory improvements; benefits in healthy midlife adults are extrapolation.

sources.label: FoundMyFitness polyphenols and brain aging topic

indications: Berry and polyphenol intake is low.
Long-horizon brain health is an explicit goal.
